description: Ticket 807: non-major updates are tier 0 and merge themselves once every required check is green. Majors wait for Sam (label `major`, tier 2 in scripts/merge-policy.mjs).

packageRules.description: Majors need Sam: no auto-merge, and the label makes them tier 2.
TypeScript 7.1 beta by Sam's decision (10 Nov 2026). Renovate ranks the nightly -dev builds above the beta, which opened a PR a day; stay on beta and rc releases.
Node stays on the 24 line, set by hand in .nvmrc, netlify.toml and engines. Major 24 picks up patches on every build; pinning would stop them, and the engines range is a minimum, not a version.
